entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I wasn't sure I'd even see you, but...[n]I guess this is good timing.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Heh... Who knows? Don't get your[n]hopes up.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Sounds like you've been through a lot.[n]It's kind of a relief to see you're the[n]same as ever.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Remember, I'm pretty close by if you[n]ever come down with something.[n]Call whenever you need to.
